breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting boundary conditions (simply-supported vs. Neumann). It discarded the incorrect Neumann condition (∂u/∂n = 0) and only included the simply-supported condition (u=0 and Δu=0), which is consistent with the ground truth and the specified numerical method.
